gates.name: live_site_release_alignment
gates.reason: Canonical v0.14 public status and website-sync handoff exist, but live-site completion remains open in issue #242 and has not been independently verified.

gates.name: public_surface_consistency
gates.reason: Homepage, data/status, release-history and support/status surfaces cannot yet be proven mutually consistent from repository state alone.

gates.name: privacy_safe_analytics_observability
gates.reason: No canonical repository record was found that defines privacy-safe analytics, duplicate-beacon prevention and telemetry boundaries for v0.15.

gates.name: uptime_https_redirects_indexing_manifests
gates.reason: Infrastructure concerns are tracked operationally, but v0.15 does not yet expose one deterministic repository gate covering uptime, HTTPS, apex/www redirects, indexing controls and public manifests.

gates.name: statistics_classification
gates.reason: Repository-derived counts already carry caveats, but measured analytics, repository-derived counts and estimates are not yet governed by one machine-readable public statistics contract.

gates.name: public_figures_provenance
gates.reason: The sealed v0.14 public-status record labels the 18,490 external-URL denominator as repository-derived rather than independently verified and records release date/provenance anchors.

gates.name: source_link_integrity_fail_closed
gates.reason: v0.14 source-coverage and source-integrity gates preserve original URLs and explicitly keep unavailable-or-changed != false.

gates.name: public_data_privacy_boundary
gates.reason: The existing public-data boundary remains CI-enforced and private Drive identifiers, paths, timestamps and file-linked hashes remain excluded.

gates.name: repository_state_release_reconstruction
gates.reason: v0.14 release readiness is reconstructable from repository state and CI through the sealed ledger and reconstruction validator.

gates.name: v015_end_to_end_readiness_workflow
gates.reason: No end-to-end v0.15 readiness workflow exists yet.

next_smallest_batch: define a machine-readable public statistics and telemetry contract
add deterministic public-status consistency checks using repository-addressable expectations
add vendor-neutral infrastructure check definitions for HTTPS redirects indexing and manifests
compose these with existing v0.14/privacy/source-integrity gates into one v0.15 readiness workflow
